# stcvlite

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/sigmafelix/stcvlite/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/sigmafelix/stcvlite/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

Lightweight extension of `rsample` for spatiotemporal cross-validation

## What does this package do?

`stcvlite` provides convenient functions to make `rset` objects for
spatiotemporal cross-validation. `rset` class is a major component of
`rsample` package, which is a part of `tidymodels` ecosystem, to perform
hyperparameter tuning and model evaluation for machine learning tasks.

## Cross-validation schemes

The package offers several cross-validation schemes by *what to split
along*, for example, leave-one-out or leave-block-out along space or
time indices or by combination of both. The principle encapsulates the
schemes as acronyms. To note, the terminology is from [Clark et
al. (2024)](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41370-024-00712-8):

| Family | Scheme | Description |
|:--:|:--:|:---|
| LOO | `"lolo"` | Leave-one-location-out. In space-time data, all time indices at each location are assigned to the same fold. |
| LOO | `"loto"` | Leave-one-time-out. In space-time data, all locations at each time index are assigned to the same fold. |
| LOO | `"lolto"` | Leave-one-location-time-out. Same as plain LOOCV |
| LBO | `"lblo"` | Leave-block-location-out. Proximal locations are chunked. |
| LBO | `"lbto"` | Leave-block-time-out. Closer time indices are chunked. |
| LBO | `"lblto"` | Leave-block-location-time-out. Both locations and time indices are considered in chunking. |
| Random | `"random"` | Random assignment. Same as plain random CV. |

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("sigmafelix/stcvlite")
```

## Quick start

``` r

library(stcvlite)

# Load the built-in sample dataset (100 locations × 120 time steps)
data(spdat)   # a data.table with lon, lat, time, x1, x2, y columns
```

## Spatial block creation

Spatial blocks group nearby locations together so that an entire block
ends up in the same fold, preventing spatial autocorrelation from
leaking between training and test sets.
[`generate_block_sp_index()`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/generate_block_sp_index.md)
attaches a `sp_index` column to the covariate table and supports three
block-definition strategies.

### Strategy 1 — density-based clustering

When `cv_fold` is supplied without `blocks`, coordinates are clustered
with DBSCAN.

``` r

# Create 5 spatial clusters based on (lon, lat)
spdat_block <- generate_block_sp_index(spdat, cv_fold = 5)
spdat_block[, c("lon", "lat", "sp_index")]
#> lon and lat columns alongside integer cluster ids 1–5
```

### Strategy 2 — regular grid (`blocks = c(step_lon, step_lat)`)

Pass a length-2 numeric vector to cut the bounding box into rectangular
cells.

``` r

# ~5° × 5° grid cells
spdat_grid <- generate_block_sp_index(spdat, blocks = c(5, 5))
spdat_grid[, c("lon", "lat", "sp_index")]
```

### Strategy 3 — arbitrary polygon blocks (`blocks = sf/SpatVector`)

Provide an `sf` or `SpatVector` polygon layer whose features define the
block boundaries (e.g. states, counties, hydrological units). The
`block_id` argument names the column that uniquely identifies each
feature.

``` r

library(sf)

# Example: U.S. state polygons (replace with your own polygon layer)
state_polygons <- sf::read_sf("path/to/states.gpkg")

spdat_poly <- generate_block_sp_index(
  spdat,
  blocks   = state_polygons,
  block_id = "STUSPS"   # unique state abbreviation column
)
spdat_poly[, c("lon", "lat", "sp_index")]
```

## Cross-validation schemes

[`generate_cv_index()`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/generate_cv_index.md)
returns an integer (or factor) fold-assignment vector with one value per
row of the input. Pass this vector together with your data to
[`convert_cv_index_rset()`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/convert_cv_index_rset.md)
to obtain a `tidymodels`-compatible `rset` object.

### Leave-one-location-out (lolo)

Each unique location forms one fold; all time steps at that location are
held out together.

``` r

data(spdat)

cv_lolo <- generate_cv_index(spdat, cv_mode = "lolo")
# cv_lolo is an integer vector of length nrow(spdat)
# unique values == number of unique locations (100)

rset_lolo <- convert_cv_index_rset(cv_lolo, spdat, cv_mode = "lolo")
rset_lolo
```

### Leave-one-time-out (loto)

Each unique time step is one fold; all locations at that time step are
held out.

``` r

cv_loto <- generate_cv_index(spdat, cv_mode = "loto")
# unique values == number of unique time steps (120)

rset_loto <- convert_cv_index_rset(cv_loto, spdat, cv_mode = "loto")
```

### Leave-one-location-time-out (lolto)

Every single row becomes its own fold (standard LOO). Suitable for small
datasets.

``` r

cv_lolto <- generate_cv_index(spdat, cv_mode = "lolto")
```

### Leave-block-location-out (lblo)

Spatially contiguous groups of locations form each fold. Uses k-means
clustering internally when `cv_fold` is an integer.

``` r

cv_lblo <- generate_cv_index(spdat, cv_mode = "lblo", cv_fold = 5)

rset_lblo <- convert_cv_index_rset(cv_lblo, spdat, cv_mode = "lblo")
rset_lblo
#> # 5-fold spatial block CV

# You can also supply pre-built polygon blocks:
# cv_lblo_poly <- generate_cv_index(
#   spdat, cv_mode = "lblo",
#   blocks = state_polygons, block_id = "STUSPS"
# )
```

### Leave-block-time-out (lbto)

Consecutive time steps are grouped into `cv_fold` temporal chunks.

``` r

cv_lbto <- generate_cv_index(spdat, cv_mode = "lbto", cv_fold = 6)

rset_lbto <- convert_cv_index_rset(cv_lbto, spdat, cv_mode = "lbto")
```

### Leave-block-location-time-out (lblto)

Combines spatial and temporal blocking. Each fold is one cell in the
`sp_fold * t_fold` grid of spatiotemporal blocks.

``` r

cv_lblto <- generate_cv_index(
  spdat,
  cv_mode = "lblto",
  sp_fold = 5,
  t_fold  = 4
)
# up to 5 × 4 = 20 unique spatiotemporal blocks

rset_lblto <- convert_cv_index_rset(cv_lblto, spdat, cv_mode = "lblto")
```

### Random (random)

Plain random k-fold assignment included as a baseline.

``` r

cv_random <- generate_cv_index(spdat, cv_mode = "random", cv_fold = 10)

rset_random <- convert_cv_index_rset(cv_random, spdat, cv_mode = "random")
```

## Visualizing folds

[`plot_cv_folds()`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/plot_cv_folds.md)
renders a 3-D scatter (lon × lat × time) colored by fold, useful for
quickly checking that the spatial/temporal structure is captured.

``` r

if (requireNamespace("plotly", quietly = TRUE)) {
  # Spatial block CV — clusters should appear as distinct spatial patches
  plot_cv_folds(spdat, cv_lblo)

  # Spatiotemporal block CV
  plot_cv_folds(spdat, cv_lblto)
}
```

## Integration with tidymodels

The `rset` objects returned by
[`convert_cv_index_rset()`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/convert_cv_index_rset.md)
are fully compatible with the `tune` and `workflows` packages.

``` r

library(rsample)
library(parsnip)
library(workflows)
library(tune)

# Define a simple linear regression model
lm_spec <- linear_reg() |> set_engine("lm")

wflow <- workflow() |>
  add_formula(y ~ x1 + x2) |>
  add_model(lm_spec)

# Evaluate using spatial block CV
cv_results_lblo <- fit_resamples(wflow, resamples = rset_lblo)
collect_metrics(cv_results_lblo)

# # A tibble: 2 × 6
#   .metric .estimator   mean     n std_err .config        
#   <chr>   <chr>       <dbl> <int>   <dbl> <chr>          
# 1 rmse    standard   5.24       5 0.0108  pre0_mod0_post0
# 2 rsq     standard   0.0116     5 0.00110 pre0_mod0_post0


# Evaluate using spatiotemporal block CV
cv_results_lbto <- fit_resamples(wflow, resamples = rset_lbto)
collect_metrics(cv_results_lbto)

# # A tibble: 2 × 6
#   .metric .estimator  mean     n std_err .config        
#   <chr>   <chr>      <dbl> <int>   <dbl> <chr>          
# 1 rmse    standard   5.53      6 1.28    pre0_mod0_post0
# 2 rsq     standard   0.303     6 0.00171 pre0_mod0_post0

# Evaluate using spatiotemporal block CV
cv_results_lblto <- fit_resamples(wflow, resamples = rset_lblto)
collect_metrics(cv_results_lblto)

# # A tibble: 2 × 6
#   .metric .estimator  mean     n std_err .config        
#   <chr>   <chr>      <dbl> <int>   <dbl> <chr>          
# 1 rmse    standard   5.02     20 0.540   pre0_mod0_post0
# 2 rsq     standard   0.155    20 0.00665 pre0_mod0_post0
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`convert_cv_index_rset()`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/convert_cv_index_rset.md)
  : Generate manual rset object from spatiotemporal cross-validation
  indices
- [`generate_block_sp_index()`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/generate_block_sp_index.md)
  : Generate blocked spatial index
- [`generate_cv_index()`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/generate_cv_index.md)
  : Generate spatio-temporal cross-validation index
- [`generate_cv_index_lblo()`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/generate_cv_index_lblo.md)
  : Generate spatio-temporal cross-validation index
  (leave-block-location-out)
- [`generate_cv_index_lblto()`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/generate_cv_index_lblto.md)
  : Generate spatio-temporal cross-validation index
  (leave-block-location-time-out)
- [`generate_cv_index_lbto()`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/generate_cv_index_lbto.md)
  : Generate spatio-temporal cross-validation index
  (leave-block-time-out)
- [`generate_cv_index_lolo()`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/generate_cv_index_lolo.md)
  : Generate spatio-temporal cross-validation index
  (leave-one-location-out)
- [`generate_cv_index_lolto()`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/generate_cv_index_lolto.md)
  : Generate spatio-temporal cross-validation index
  leave-one-location-time-out)
- [`generate_cv_index_loto()`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/generate_cv_index_loto.md)
  : Generate spatio-temporal cross-validation index (leave-one-time-out)
- [`generate_cv_index_random()`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/generate_cv_index_random.md)
  : Generate spatio-temporal cross-validation index (random)
- [`generate_spt_index()`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/generate_spt_index.md)
  : Generate unique spatiotemporal identifier from stdt object
- [`plot_cv_folds()`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/plot_cv_folds.md)
  : Plot generated CV folds
- [`prep_input()`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/prep_input.md)
  : Convert sf and sftime objects to stdt format
- [`spdat`](https://sigmafelix.github.io/stcvlite/reference/spdat.md) :
  Sample full spatiotemporal point data
